profile: war/1.2 composition vectors C01-C16 (maximusrufus/work-acceptance-record, composition/vectors at 8ce7f42), bundled unchanged for run-vectors.ts

source.author: maximusrufus
source.licenseNote: LICENSES.md of the source repository dedicates composition/vectors/ under CC0 1.0, and each source file carries "license": "CC0-1.0". The bundle keeps id, title, note, inputs and expect of each file; file and sha256 name the source.

vectors.title: Valid pair, declared-evidence authority
vectors.note: Acceptance names W1 under war/1.2; W1 authenticates under the listed checker key.

vectors.title: Valid pair, payer/0 authority from the work record's payment member
vectors.note: payment.payer is mixed case; the derived payer is lowercased.

vectors.title: Subject reference does not match the work record digest
vectors.note: subject.reference and contextId carry a digest one hex digit off from sha256(JCS(receipt)).

vectors.title: Unsupported subject profile
vectors.note: subject.profile war/9 is not one this verifier supports.

vectors.title: Wrong profile id for a work record
vectors.note: A work record named under x402ev/1. This checker does not implement x402ev/1, so the profile is unavailable; a verifier that implements x402ev/1 reports evidence_unavailable, because a work record does not authenticate as execution evidence.

vectors.title: Work record edited after signing
vectors.note: The supplied work record's signature no longer verifies, so the subject is unavailable.

vectors.title: Acceptance record edited after signing
vectors.note: The JWS payload is replaced by JCS of the body with disposition rejected; signature kept.

vectors.title: Both records valid, not bound to each other
vectors.note: The acceptance names W1; the supplied subject is W2, a different valid record from the same checker on the same file and criteria.

vectors.title: issuedAt before a fractional issued_utc
vectors.note: issued_utc 12:00:00.500Z rounds up to t+1; issuedAt is t.

vectors.title: issuedAt equal to the rounded-up issued_utc
Acceptance signed with the work record's checker key
vectors.note: trust.keys maps the checker key to another signer string; AR-33 still fires on the key.

vectors.title: Work record signed by a key the relying party does not list
Declared authority names a different work record
vectors.note: The trust.authority entry's subjectReference is W2's identity.
